aiResearchSummary.text: Odys Aviation is focused on developing hybrid-electric VTOL aircraft for regional mobility. Their research includes multiple flight mode aircraft architectures and controls, featuring wings with actuating flaps that enable seamless transitions between forward cruise and vertical hover modes. This innovation supports the creation of versatile aircraft capable of efficient regional travel.
